description:
Lawful development: Existing use.
This statement is submitted in support of an application for a Lawful Development Certificate (Existing Use) for the continued use of the above property as a House in Multiple Occupation (HMO). The purpose of this statement is to demonstrate that the property has been used continuously and lawfully as an HMO for a period exceeding 10 years, and therefore the use is now lawful due to the passage of time under Section 191 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.



2. Background and Relevant Legislation


Under planning law, an HMO use becomes lawful if it has occurred without interruption for a period of 10 years or more, and no enforcement action has been taken within that period.

Therefore, the key test is the balance of probability that the HMO use has existed continuously for at least 10 years before the date of the application.
